title: No relay command removes a merged leftover branch
what: One relay command (or relay doctor's suggested step) removes a task worktree and its branch when the worktree is clean and the branch has no commit outside the default branch, and refuses otherwise naming what it holds; the guard's refusal of `git branch -d` names that command.
why: 30 Oct: wt/queue-edit and wt/relay-plugins were clean and fully in master, but `git branch -d` from the main checkout is refused by guard-main and relay has no command that removes a leftover branch, so the branches stay; the worktrees were removed with `git worktree remove`. relay doctor lists leftovers but names no removal step. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: 30 Oct, /Users/amidman/relay: `git branch -d wt/queue-edit` refused by guard-main; `bin/relay help` lists no removal command.
pass_cases: A clean branch fully in master is removed with its worktree by the command
A branch with a commit outside master is refused, the refusal names the commits
The guard's refusal of git branch -d names the command
